secrets.gm_note: No check. If the crate is never opened, the coin comes as a Weird pull in the first Green Room box (lore card f01-z09-0001), or from Dale's pocket if he dies. Must be planted on Floor 1.

Same reply for sell, identify or appraise (Snakk-Matic, spell, check, or asking an NPC). Selling can instead get a 500-credit offer that cancels mid-animation. Never name a floor, fee or time. Never explain it.

triggers.when: someone says they are checking behind the machines

secrets.reveal_text: A false panel behind the change machine opens the back cage.
